title: Set up your property
subtitle: A few steps to be ready for your first guests. You can change everything later in the settings.
skipConfirmText: You can resume it from the dashboard at any time.
forbidden: Only the owner (or an administrator) can set up the property.

property.title: Your property
property.text: This information appears on your invoices and documents.
property.name: Property name

roomTypes.title: Room types
roomTypes.text: Describe your room categories (standard, superior, suite…). You will create the rooms in the next step.
roomTypes.name: Type name

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.text: Create your rooms by number range, for each type. Example: from 101 to 112.
rooms.needTypes: First add at least one room type (previous step).
rooms.remaining: {{count}} more room(s) available with your plan.
rooms.quotaExceeded: Quota reached: your plan allows {{limit}} room(s) and {{used}} already exist. Reduce the range or change plan.

errors.range: "To" must be greater than or equal to "From" (500 rooms maximum).

rates.title: Rates
rates.text: Set the nightly price of each room type (base public rate).
rates.needTypes: First add at least one room type.
rates.seasonText: A different price over a period of the year (holidays, festivals…).

errors.price: Enter a whole price in CFA francs.
errors.season: Fill in the high season name and dates (end ≥ start).

taxes.title: Taxes
taxes.text: Taxes are added to invoices automatically, according to your country's rules.
taxes.vatText: Standard rate, applied to lodging and services.
taxes.touristText: Fixed amount per guest per night. Check the current amount with your municipality.

errors.amount: Enter a whole amount greater than 0.

team.title: Your team
team.text: Invite your colleagues: they receive an e-mail to choose their password. Optional step.
team.name: Name
team.emailTaken: This address is already in use.

branding.title: Branding
branding.text: Your logo and colours appear in the app, e-mails and invoices.
branding.uploadHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, 5 MB maximum.
branding.contrast: Low contrast with white text: pick a darker colour.

recap.title: Summary
recap.text: Here is what you configured. Everything remains editable in the settings.
recap.demoText: Adds a few fictional rooms, guests and products to explore the app. You can delete them in one click from the settings.
recap.demoQuota: Demo rooms count toward your room quota.

checklist.title: Finish your setup
checklist.text: {{done}} of {{total}} step(s) completed. Complete your property to welcome your first guests.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.placeholder: Operating indicators will come with the reservation modules.

demo.title: Demonstration data
demo.text: Fictional data loaded by the setup wizard (rooms, guests, products). Each row is tracked: deleting never touches your own data.
demo.deleteConfirmText: Only the data created by the demonstration will be deleted.
